section.heading: Animal population health and education program.

para.text: The Mayor shall implement an animal population health and education program, which shall include the provision of:
Low-cost or no-cost preventive and emergency veterinary services; and
Low-cost or no-cost spay and neuter clinic services; and
Educational services, including with respect to:
Pet care and safety, including pet care and safety in extreme weather conditions or emergencies; and
District laws related to pet ownership.
The Mayor may establish eligibility standards for animal care services provided pursuant to subsection (a)(1) of this section.

annotations.annotation: Delegation of authority pursuant to law 3-30, see Mayor’s Order 83-206, August 2, 1983.
